notes.title: Iconoclasts, now in Chinese!
notes.content:
Iconoclasts is now available in Chinese through publisher Gamera Game!

We are very happy that the game is now playable in Chinese.

- Support for Traditional and Simplified Chinese

tags.feature: - Support for Traditional and Simplified Chinese

notes.title: Boss Rush - Patch 1.15
notes.content:
We are happy to announce that the latest update has some new and exciting features to coincide with Iconoclasts launching on the Nintendo Switch!

[b]Boss Rush[/b] unlocks once you have completed the game. It allows you to relive the most exciting moments of Iconoclasts. Battle through a timed gauntlet of increasingly difficult bosses.

[b]Relaxed Mode[/b] introduces a new, easier, difficulty. Unwind and play the game at your own pace.

Found Iconoclasts too hard or easy? You can now change difficulty whenever you load a new game.


Patch Notes:
- Added Boss Rush mode
- Added "Relaxed" low difficulty mode
- You may now choose difficulty on loading a game
- Fixed Elro disappearing during the Carver battle
- Various smaller fixes
